metas.name: Heist 88
metas.description: A criminal mastermind recruits a group of young bank employees to steal 80 million dollars in one of the largest bank heist in US history.

metas.name: A Tattoo on My Brain
metas.description: A documentary based on Daniel Gibbs' book A Tattoo on My Brain: A Neurologist's Personal Battle against Alzheimer's Disease.

metas.name: A Really Haunted Loud House
metas.description: Lincoln and his best friend, Clyde, struggle to decide whether to participate in the Loud family Spooktacular, attend their friend, Xander's, party, or go trick-or-treating on Halloween.

metas.name: Pet Sematary: Bloodlines
metas.description: In 1969, young Jud Crandall has dreams of leaving his hometown behind, but soon discovers sinister secrets buried within and is forced to confront a dark family history that forever binds him to Ludlow.

metas.name: Love & Murder: Atlanta Playboy
metas.description: Follows Lance, a prominent Atlanta businessman known for both revamping the city's 911 system and his proclivity for women. There are many theories and claims about who would have wished him dead when he is discovered dead in his own home.

metas.name: PAW Patrol: The Mighty Movie
metas.description: A magical meteor crash lands in Adventure City and gives the PAW Patrol pups superpowers, transforming them into The Mighty Pups.

metas.name: Finestkind
metas.description: Two brothers from opposite sides of the tracks are reunited as adults. Desperate circumstances force them into a deal with an organized crime syndicate in Boston, and a young woman gets caught in the middle.

metas.name: Office Race
metas.description: An unambitious office worker goes to great lengths—specifically 26.2 miles—to one up his exercise-obsessed, micromanaging boss.

metas.name: The Caine Mutiny Court-Martial
metas.description: Barney Greenwald, a skeptical lawyer, reluctantly defends an officer of the navy who took control of the Caine from its captain, Lt. Philip Francis Queeg, while caught in a violent sea storm. As the court-martial proceeds, however, Greenwald increasingly questions if it was truly a mutiny or rather the courageous acts of a group of sailors who could not trust their unstable leader.

metas.name: Last Song from Kabul
metas.description: Immerses us in the devastating reality of Afghanistan after the Taliban  occupation: music has been banned. Forced into hiding, a group of young musicians attempt a harrowing escape to Portugal. Will they be able to find their voices again?

metas.name: Blippi's Big Dino Adventure
metas.description: When Blippi and Meekah run into Park Ranger Asher and his energetic dinosaur crew at T-Rex Ranch, Asher asks the duo for their help to retrieve the missing dinosaur eggs.

metas.name: The Eternal Memory
metas.description: Augusto and Paulina have been together for 25 years. Eight years ago, he was diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. Both fear the day he no longer recognizes her.

metas.name: Cruel Encounters
metas.description: After the founder of a huge holding company dies in a mysterious helicopter crash, his wife, son and daughter jockey for the reins of his company in a struggle that involves deception, intrigue and murder.

metas.name: Sleepy Hollow
metas.description: The film based on the story of the American writer Washington Irving "The Legend of Sleepy Hollow" tells about the relationship of a person "suffering" from "teacher's syndrome" with his environment.

metas.name: Birthing a Nation: The Resistance of Mary Gaffney
metas.description: Birthing A Nation: The Resistance of Mary Gaffney explores the story of forced reproduction in the antebellum South and reveals the agency of Mary Gaffney, an enslaved woman who takes control of her body and fertility.

metas.name: Sisters
metas.description: After losing their mothers at a young age, Diamond and her closest cousins, Tia and Tara, known as "Sisters", are willing to do anything to keep their grandmother from dying of cancer and save their family.

metas.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem
metas.description: After years of being sheltered from the human world, the Turtle brothers set out to win the hearts of New Yorkers and be accepted as normal teenagers through heroic acts. Their new friend April O'Neil helps them take on a mysterious crime syndicate, but they soon get in over their heads when an army of mutants is unleashed upon them.
